item.title: IEA rejects Pakistan’s claims linking Islamabad blast to Afghanistan
item.description: Afghanistan’s Ministry of Defence, responding to recent remarks by Pakistan’s defence minister linking Friday’s explosion in Islamabad to Afghanistan, has said that such statements and the attribution of the attack to Afghanistan have no logic or factual basis.

item.title: ICC Men’s T20 World Cup begins today
item.description: The 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup gets under way today (Saturday), with Pakistan facing the Netherlands in the opening match at the Sinhalese Sports Club Ground in Sri Lanka.

item.title: Basharat brothers gear up for UFC fights in Las Vegas
item.description: Afghan mixed martial arts fighters Javid Basharat and Farid Basharat are set to face opponents from Mexico and Brazil, respectively, in Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) bouts tomorrow (Sunday).
